post.summary: Have Paystack asked about a payment now
post.description: For the storefront's return page. Paystack sends the shopper back to the checkout's `return_url` with `reference` added; posting it here asks Paystack at once, rather than waiting for the webhook, and records a successful payment through the engine's own check. Nothing Paystack did not report is recorded. The answer is the order's number and payment status, nothing more. An order already paid is answered from the store without asking Paystack again, and Paystack is asked at most once every 15 seconds for one reference; calls in between are answered from the store. 409 when the order has since moved to another payment method. 404 for a reference this store did not open, or while Paystack is not set up.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: The reference from the checkout's `client_data.reference`, or the `reference` Paystack added to the return URL.

200.description: The order's payment status after asking.
